content: {"rules": ["Model forecasts exhibit significant mean-reversion bias, consistently underestimating strong upward trends in true outcomes.", "Sentiment scores above 0.67 correlate with forecast overshoots where the model fails to capture rapid price spikes.", "Forecasts lag behind actual price movements during volatile periods, showing a systematic delay of 3-5 days.", "When sentiment drops below 0.33, the model overestimates prices by failing to account for sharp downward corrections.", "The model assumes linear growth, causing it to miss non-linear volatility patterns in the EU ETS market.", "Recent history prices heavily influence forecasts, leading to inertia that prevents quick adaptation to new market regimes.", "Sentiment history with mixed signals (0.00 to 1.00) results in the highest forecast errors due to conflicting trend indicators.", "The model systematically underpredicts prices when true outcomes exceed the 80 EUR threshold regardless of sentiment."]}
